evaluation.actual_media: 204 bytes per terminal, lossless 1568 binary pixels plus 8 uint8 token IDs; calibration drafts in gzip binary stream; logs gzip
evaluation.future_stream: seed, source case, view, draw, committed action path; excludes policy
evaluation.oracle_scope: Empirical table maximum and sampled pairwise ranking errors are hindsight diagnostics, never online-achievable optimality certificates
evaluation.paired_actor_cost: Both standalone alternatives execute both small heads; report this actual diagnostic implementation, no actor-only cost claim
evaluation.request_cost: Actual generation, all public features and policy/fallback calls, public action commitment gzip/flush/fsync, durable packed terminal media append/fsync/exact readback
evaluation.selected_action_calibration: For each cheap-evaluated H1 decision, compare selected paired-moment prediction with exp(-2*(actual terminal utility-.002*nonstop))-exp(-2*current stop draft utility), scored privately after closed media; no conditional uniform-error claim
evaluation.separate_cost: Training, model load, source preparation, compressed calibration archive outside request clock, independent closed-media scoring, analysis; all included in child process total
evaluation.statistical_scope: Descriptive source-and-seed paired bootstrap conditional on already-used historical sources; not prospective new-source superiority

prospective_evaluation.actual_media: 204 bytes per terminal, lossless 1568 binary pixels plus 8 uint8 token IDs; calibration drafts in gzip binary stream; logs gzip
prospective_evaluation.all_candidates: paired_critic and distilled_actor retained as diagnostic alternatives; cannot replace the selected_gate after evaluation
prospective_evaluation.future_stream: seed, source case, view, draw, committed action path; excludes policy
prospective_evaluation.intervals: Nominal 97.5% two-sided percentile component intervals; price curves nominal 95% max-absolute-centered bands separately per wall/CPU contrast; no finite-sample coverage guarantee
prospective_evaluation.oracle_scope: Empirical table maximum and sampled pairwise ranking errors are hindsight diagnostics, never online-achievable optimality certificates
prospective_evaluation.paired_actor_cost: Both standalone alternatives execute both small heads; report this actual diagnostic implementation, no actor-only cost claim
prospective_evaluation.primary_family: selected_gate minus cached_teacher: raw CE >= -.005 AND exact success >= -.005 AND mean request wall cost < 0; zero margin superiority separately reported, never substitute a failed family
prospective_evaluation.request_cost: Actual generation, all public features and policy/fallback calls, public action commitment gzip/flush/fsync, durable packed terminal media append/fsync/exact readback
prospective_evaluation.selected_action_calibration: For each cheap-evaluated H1 decision, compare selected paired-moment prediction with exp(-2*(actual terminal utility-.002*nonstop))-exp(-2*current stop draft utility), scored privately after closed media; no conditional uniform-error claim
prospective_evaluation.separate_cost: Training, model load, source preparation, compressed calibration archive outside request clock, independent closed-media scoring, analysis; all included in child process total
prospective_evaluation.statistical_scope: Prospective registered sources; crossed source-pair and training-seed paired bootstrap, nominal inference with five seeds and no unknown-writer independence certification

scope: Historical development sources, newly sampled independent generation futures; zero new independent source claims

selection.admission: Development raw CE and exact success cannot be below the original teacher point estimates
selection.choice: Largest CE of utility minus .002 per action minus .002 times measured microbenchmark quoted control milliseconds; deterministic fallback wins ties
selection.fallback_candidate: Original cached strong feedback with no cheap precheck
selection.gate: Cheap actor and paired critic must agree and actor confidence must pass frozen threshold; otherwise execute original cached teacher
selection.quote: 128 current historical fit-node kernel timings; teacher generator-draft CNN plus public-draft CNN plus head versus cheap features plus both heads; median, not a full-request or energy estimate
selection.source: Existing forecast_calibration[448,576), all recorded views/scenarios; explicitly reused development

training.actor: Cross-entropy distillation of frozen strong feedback action, no scoring outcome as actor input
training.critic: MSE on paired positive exponential-moment action-minus-stop differences
training.h2: Other-source-fold H1 picks from current child features, then its actual offline terminal outcome labels H2; no hindsight-best label
training.source: Existing forecast_fit[480,736), all 8 views and 2 recorded generation scenarios
